unparsed.note: Ban zones (路上喫煙禁止区域) only around Kamakura and Ofuna stations; fine 2,000 yen after warning/order. Zone maps kamakura.pdf / oofuna.pdf are images; saved, not vectorised.
All station surroundings in Fujisawa are ban zones (incl. 片瀬江ノ島, 江ノ島 (Enoden), 湘南江の島). The zone maps for those stations show no designated smoking place. Only Fujisawa station has two.
City links JT "喫煙所MAP" (CLUB JT, incl. private places). Not used: commercial site, no open data licence.
